addBeneficiary(address,uint256,uint256,u.custom:error: TokenVesting__InvalidBeneficiaryAddress if beneficiary is zero address.TokenVesting__BeneficiaryAlreadyExists if beneficiary already has a vesting schedule.TokenVesting__InvalidAllocationAmount if totalAllocation is zero.TokenVesting__InvalidStartTime if startTime is zero.TokenVesting__InvalidVestingDuration if vestingDuration is zero.TokenVesting__CliffDurationIsGreaterThanVestingDuration if cliff >= vesting duration.
addBeneficiary(address,uint256,uint256,u.details: Only the contract owner can call this function. Creates a VestingSchedule          struct with the provided parameters and stores it in the vestingSchedules          mapping. Validates all inputs to ensure data integrity. Tracks total          allocation to prevent over-allocation. Emits BeneficiaryAdded event.

params.beneficiary: Address of the beneficiary who will receive vested tokens.
params.cliffDuration: Duration in seconds before any tokens unlock.
params.startTime: Timestamp when the vesting period begins.
params.totalAllocation: Total tokens allocated to this beneficiary over the full vesting period.
params.vestingDuration: Total duration in seconds from start to 100% vested.

claimVestedTokens(address).custom:error: TokenVesting__BeneficiaryDoesNotExist if beneficiary has no vesting schedule.TokenVesting__ZeroTokensToClaim if no tokens are currently claimable.TokenVesting__TransferFailed if the ERC20 token transfer fails.
claimVestedTokens(address).details: Only callable by external parties. Calculates claimable amount as the difference          between total vested and already claimed tokens. Reverts if beneficiary does not          exist, has no claimable tokens, or if the token transfer fails. Emits TokensClaimed          event and updates amountClaimed state.

params.beneficiary: Address of the beneficiary claiming their vested tokens.

returns._0: The amount of tokens successfully transferred to the beneficiary.

constructor.custom:error: TokenVesting__InvalidToken if _vestingToken is the zero address.
constructor.details: Sets the contract owner to the deployer via Ownable. Validates that the          provided token address is not the zero address to prevent contract bricking.          VESTING_TOKEN is immutable and cannot be changed after deployment, ensuring          security and gas efficiency.

params._vestingToken: Address of the ERC20 token to be vested.

getVestedAmount(address).details: Returns zero if the beneficiary does not exist, the schedule is revoked,          or the cliff period has not yet expired. Returns the full totalAllocation          once the entire vesting duration has elapsed. For timestamps between cliff          expiration and vesting period end, calculates a linear vesting amount based          on elapsed time as a fraction of the total vesting duration.

params.beneficiary: Address of the beneficiary to query.

returns._0: Total amount of tokens vested at block.timestamp, in wei. Does not account          for tokens already claimed.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

revokeSchedule(address).custom:error: TokenVesting__BeneficiaryDoesNotExist if beneficiary has no vesting schedule.TokenVesting__ScheduleAlreadyRevoked if the schedule is already revoked.
revokeSchedule(address).details: Only the contract owner can call this function. Captures the vested amount          at the time of revocation, allowing the beneficiary to claim tokens vested          up to that moment. Future vesting stops immediately upon revocation.          Emits BeneficiaryVestingScheduleRevoked event with the claimable amount.

params.beneficiary: Address of the beneficiary whose vesting schedule will be revoked.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

addBeneficiary(address,uint256,uint256,u.notice: Adds a new beneficiary with a custom vesting schedule.

claimVestedTokens(address).notice: Claims and transfers vested tokens to the beneficiary.

constructor.notice: Initialises the TokenVesting contract with the vesting token address.

getVestedAmount(address).notice: Calculates the total amount of tokens that have vested for a beneficiary.

revokeSchedule(address).notice: Revokes a beneficiary's vesting schedule, preventing future vesting.
